title: Attribution sweep: credit every shipped LoRA whose creator asks for it
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-528 - The licensing surface (consolidation sweep 2026-08-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-528/plan.md.

We ship community LoRAs (Klein styles + turbo + NSFW, Krea2 styles, Qwen-Edit Lightning, LTX, SDXL). Most carry permissive CivitAI flags; some set allowNoCredit:false, i.e. the creator wants attribution. Sweep every LoRA dep we host, find those, and credit them in the app.

METHOD (proven on MPI-354, 2026-07-26): CivitAI resolves ANY file by hash - GET https://civitai.com/api/v1/model-versions/by-hash/<sha256> returns modelId, then GET /api/v1/models/<id> returns allowNoCredit, allowCommercialUse, allowDerivatives, allowDifferentLicense and the creator username. Every dep in loraDeps.js already carries a real sha256, so the whole sweep is one script over DEPS - no page hunting, no guessing. Non-CivitAI weights (fal, HF, our own) 404 on the hash lookup; list them separately for a manual pass.

KNOWN HIT ALREADY: klein-style-anime (civitai.com/models/2227157, New Mecha style) has allowNoCredit:false. Expect more across Krea2/Qwen/LTX.

SURFACE: the app has NO About/credits screen today (grepped 2026-07-26 - nothing in js/workspaces or the shell). Deciding where credits live is part of this card: an About panel, a Settings section, or a per-model line in the Model Library sidebar. Simplest shippable version wins - a static generated markdown/HTML list is fine, it does not need to be live-fetched.

NOT A BLOCKER for any model wiring. Baking LoRAs into checkpoints without credit is endemic in this ecosystem; we credit because we choose to, not because a ship gate demands it.
acceptance: One script walks every LoRA dep in DEPS, resolves it on CivitAI by sha256, and reports allowNoCredit / creator / model URL
Non-CivitAI weights are listed separately as a manual pass, never silently skipped
Output committed as a checked-in list so the sweep can be re-run and diffed after new models land
Credits surface exists in the app and names every creator whose LoRA sets allowNoCredit:false
klein-style-anime (2227157) appears in it - the known hit
